## Summary
Reposition the existing Vite/React portfolio around **안진경 | An Jin Gyeong**, **실시간 영상 AI의 정확도와 지연을 함께 개선한 컴퓨터비전 엔지니어**, and **정답에도 유효시간이 있습니다.** The revision is copy/data/PDF focused: retain the landing-page order, design system, cards-to-modal behavior, `/#/print`, `/resume/`, and `/wiki/` route/assets.

`public/resume/index.html` is the sole editable canonical resume source and remains served at `/resume/`. Generate only `public/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서.pdf` from it; the PDF is generated output, never an independently edited source. It must render as **exactly two A4 pages**. `/#/print` remains a route-preserved **portfolio print view**, not a second resume: it carries only the shared identity/title/hook and verified link invariants, plus its existing return/print interaction; it must not duplicate detailed resume metrics, dates, or project-result narratives.

Repository evidence: `src/App.tsx` owns the `HashRouter` and `/print` route; `public/resume/index.html` is the static `/resume/` payload; `src/data/projects.ts` drives `ProjectsSection`; `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs` recursively reads markdown and writes the retained wiki JSON assets. Existing `package.json` exposes `lint`, `test`, `build`, and `wiki:index` but has no Playwright/Puppeteer/PDF parser dependency. Existing decision-copy PDF is corroborating prior copy, not an editable source or direct implementation/config evidence.

## Intent Diff
- **From:** broad full-stack/AI claims, conflicting print/resume variants, three `Main` projects, exposed LLM Wiki/RAG card, and medical/production phrasing that outruns the available authority.
- **To:** a CV-first, evidence-scoped portfolio led by Smart Safety; RF-DETR and VAE as bounded supporting work; one canonical static resume/PDF; and a compatibility print route with no parallel resume facts.
- **Unchanged:** React/Vite/Tailwind architecture; visual tokens, section order, mobile-one/desktop-two project grids, project dialog mechanics, `/#/print`, `/resume/`, `/wiki/`, `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs`, retained wiki indexes/assets, and all unselected resumes/docs.

## Decision Drivers
1. **Claim authority beats copy consistency.** Existing prose/PDF is corroboration, not proof of implementation, deployment, sole ownership, or clinical effectiveness.
2. **One editable CV source.** `/resume/` static HTML is canonical; named PDF is derived; `/#/print` is deliberately a different portfolio artifact.
3. **Minimal change.** Reuse project data, existing cards/modal, existing print route, and existing visual system. Do not redesign or introduce a new document pipeline.
4. **Dirty work is user-owned.** The prior recorded status is historical, not a live baseline. Preservation must start with live Git evidence and snapshots.
5. **Only production surfaces are copy-gated.** Historical docs may contain retained claims; they are neither mutation targets nor current-public-copy test inputs.

## Options
| Option | Decision | Rationale |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A — static `/resume/` canonical + derived named PDF + route-preserved portfolio print | **Selected** | Minimal route behavior change, direct static serving, ATS-friendly source, unambiguous PDF provenance. |
| B — React `/#/print` canonical with `/resume/` shell/redirect | Rejected | Alters static route behavior and creates higher source/print drift risk. Reconsider only through a new architecture decision if static HTML cannot meet the explicit print gate. |
| Synchronize every resume/docs/print copy | Rejected | Conflicts with historical-file preservation and multiplies unsupported-claim drift. |
| Always run `wiki:index` | Rejected | Generator recursively ingests docs and rewrites retained public JSON; it is not a read-only verification gate. |

## In scope
- Metadata, Header, Hero, About, project data/copy, minimal Experience/Competence corrections, and focused copy/interaction tests.
- Smart Safety as the only `Main`; RF-DETR/VAE as `Supporting`; removal of only the LLM object from the public `projects` array.
- Static `/resume/` rewrite, explicit two-A4-page source CSS, generated named PDF, and link/PDF QA.
- `/#/print` copy reduction to a portfolio print view with shared identity/link invariants only.
- Current production-source and retained-wiki verification manifests.

## Out of scope
- AI Worker/backend/frontend/infra implementation, model retraining, new experiments, deployment, clinical validation, benchmark reruns, data review, or visual redesign.
- Editing/deleting `docs/resume/**`, root resume/portfolio markdown, prior PDFs, wiki documentation, `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs`, `public/wiki/**`, retained LLM/RAG code/assets/routes, or other unselected artifacts.
- Removing LLM/RAG references outside the public `projects` array or rewriting README solely to hide retained wiki material.
- Adding browser/PDF dependencies or a new document-generation framework merely for this change.

## Production-surface manifest and copy ownership
| Surface / deployed role | Exact location | Required exact literals | Conflict-free-only rule / test scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| App metadata | `index.html`: `<title>`, description, `og:title`, `og:description` | Name + title in title/OG title; hook in description/OG description | No `Full-Stack`, broad AI/ML title, RAG-first positioning, or unsupported production claim. |
| Fixed header | `src/components/Header.tsx`: brand `<span>` | `안진경 | An Jin Gyeong` | Header need not repeat title/hook; it must contain no competing identity/title and preserve nav/menu/scroll behavior. |
| Hero | `src/components/HeroSection.tsx`: eyebrow/name, `<h1>`, hook paragraph | Name in eyebrow, title in `h1`, hook in dedicated visible line | State CV candidacy and the team-delivered `AI Worker → MQTT → Spring Boot → WebSocket → React` flow with scope qualifier; ≤3 working CTAs. |
| About | `src/components/AboutSection.tsx`: title/profile introduction and focus copy | Name/title/hook in visible profile block | No generic LinkedIn root URL or `href="#"`; remove their icons/anchors rather than invent destinations. No RF-DETR FPS/real-time, VAE diagnosis, deployment, or RAG-first positioning. |
| Project presentation | `src/data/projects.ts`; `src/components/ProjectsSection.tsx` | Smart Safety first and sole `Main`; RF-DETR/VAE `Supporting` | Does not need repeated shared brand. It must be free of scoped-banned claims, preserve card/modal/grid/key behavior, and contain no LLM object/card/modal. |
| Experience | `src/components/ExperienceSection.tsx`: SK course entry; RF-DETR/VAE descriptions | Course date `2026.01–2026.07` | Do not repeat brand/title/hook. Correct only conflicting copy: no RF-DETR real-time/clinical claim; VAE is anomaly-candidate visualization, not lesion/tumor detection; do not call the dated course “in progress.” Preserve timeline/layout. |
| Competence | `src/components/CompetenceSection.tsx`: intelligent-app card subtitle/body/tags | Course date `2026.01–2026.07` if shown | Do not repeat brand/title/hook. Remove “actual deployment” and broad full-stack/production positioning; use neutral course-learning wording. Preserve certificate modal handlers, Escape/overlay behavior, card layout, and certificate assets. |
| Portfolio print route | `src/pages/PortfolioPrint.tsx`, `src/styles/print.css` at `/#/print` | Visible name, title, hook; actual GitHub and Portfolio anchors; canonical `/resume/` and named-PDF links | Explicitly label **포트폴리오 인쇄 보기**. Retain return and `window.print()` controls. Remove the duplicate two-page resume/result sections, project metrics, training/project dates, Dice/FPS, and detailed contribution prose; it is not subject to canonical-resume page count. |
| Canonical resume | `public/resume/index.html`: header role/tagline and linked content | Header name, role title, hook; actual GitHub and Portfolio HTTPS anchors | Sole editable resume; ATS order is contact/links → profile → skills → Smart Safety → RF-DETR → VAE → education → awards/credentials. No LLM/RAG, stale full-stack claims, or banned claims. |
| Generated release artifact | `public/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서.pdf`, copied by build to `dist/resume/…` | Exact Korean filename | Generated only from canonical HTML; exactly two A4 pages; link annotations for GitHub and Portfolio; hash/provenance required. |
| Retained wiki | `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs`, `public/wiki/search-index.json`, `public/wiki/rag-vector-index.json` | Existing search/incident metadata contract | Separate retained-wiki tests only. Do not scan these files for current portfolio-copy bans and do not run generation unless an intentionally indexed source changes. |

Historical `docs/resume/**`, root markdown resumes, PDFs, backups, and other docs are explicitly absent from all production-copy manifests and negative scans.

## Claim-by-claim authority matrix
Authority classes: **U** user-approved requirement; **I** direct implementation/config in this repository; **C** prior copy corroborated by the decision PDF/current data; **X** unsupported here. U controls required brand/date/selection decisions; I is required for operational/deployment claims; C is publishable only with the stated narrow qualifier; X is omitted.

| Claim | Source / class | Allowed public wording | Rejection condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Name, title, hook, canonical route/PDF name, exact two-page goal | User requirement / **U** | Exact literals in manifest | Any competing title or renamed artifact. |
| Degree and graduation `건양대학교 의공학과 학사 | 2026.02 졸업` | User requirement plus prior resume / **U+C** | Exact resume wording | Do not substitute a generic graduation year. |
| Course attendance `SK쉴더스 지능형 애플리케이션 개발 과정 5기 | 2026.01–2026.07` | User requirement; decision PDF / **U+C** | Course entry only, fixed date | Never collapse it into the Smart Safety duration or say ongoing after that date. |
| Smart Safety project `2026.05–2026.07` | User requirement; decision PDF / **U+C** | Project date only, separately labeled | Never present it as the course duration. |
| Team delivery chain `AI Worker → MQTT → Spring Boot → WebSocket → React` | Decision-copy/current prose; no implementation repos / **C** | “팀 시스템의 전달 흐름” or equivalent; personal work separately qualified | No “solely built”, “end-to-end owned”, or unqualified production implementation. |
| Feature expansion and F1/FP/FN results | Decision PDF / **C** | Add upper-body tilt, vertical drop, speed; under the stated comparable evaluation, F1 `89.29→93.49`, FP `−38.6%`, FN `−38.9%` | No clinical/production/general accuracy claim. **51D baseline:** no acceptable primary authority is currently present; omit `51D→54D` and say only “54D로 확장” unless a direct report/config or written user approval is captured before editing. |
| Staged reconnect and ID/coverage results | Decision PDF / **C** | Predicted position, normalized center distance, candidate-count stages; evaluation-video `ID Switch 8→1`, coverage `35.76→49.70` | Ban Re-ID, MOTA, HOTA, or generic tracking-accuracy wording. |
| Multi-camera latency | Decision PDF / **C** | Same multi-camera condition: mean `11.789→6.101 ms (−48.2%)`, worst-camera p95 `14.719→7.159 ms (−51.4%)` | No deployed-SLA/general throughput claim. |
| TensorRT comparison | Decision PDF / **C** | Same 1,800-frame comparison: PyTorch `7.022 ms / 84.278 FPS`; TensorRT `3.839 ms / 119.544 FPS` | Ban production optimization/deployment, persistent engine use, or a claim beyond comparison validation. |
| Reader/Inference split, queue, drop-old, timestamps | Only historical checklist/prose; no direct report/code / **X** | Omit | Never promote prior prose to implementation evidence. |
| RF-DETR team/project/metric | User requirement + prior copy / **U+C** | Team project; Kvasir 70/20/10; personal Elastic/Grid augmentation and bbox validation; team `mAP@50 86.2%`; PyQt5/OpenCV video/webcam prototype | Ban “real-time,” FPS, clinical use, deployment, individual model ownership, and unsupported baseline uplift. |
| VAE | User requirement + prior copy / **U+C** | Normal-only training; reconstruction-error map; brightness/noise limitation of fixed threshold; personal dynamic-threshold post-processing; candidate visualization | Ban diagnosis, clinical performance/effectiveness, lesion/tumor detection claim, Dice, and sole model ownership. |
| Deployment/clinical validation/sole ownership/Re-ID | No code/config/approval / **X** | Omit | Any unqualified use blocks publication. |

### Scoped banned-claim policy
Apply negatives only to the production manifest (not historical docs or retained wiki): `Full-Stack Software Engineer`, `Production-ready AI Engineer`, Reader/Inference queue, bounded queue, drop-old, Re-ID, MOTA, HOTA, “production TensorRT,” deployment/deployed, clinical validation/effectiveness/diagnosis, RF-DETR real-time/FPS, VAE Dice/lesion/tumor detection, sole/entire/end-to-end ownership, and LLM Wiki/RAG as a public selected project. Allowed limitation text such as “비임상”, “프로토타입”, “검증 범위와 한계”, and “팀 프로젝트” must remain allowed.

## File-level changes
| Target | Minimal change |
| --- | --- |
| `index.html` | Correct title/description/OG metadata according to manifest; retain bootstrap, favicon, and OG image. |
| `src/components/Header.tsx` | Replace only displayed brand literal; preserve nav/menu/scroll state. |
| `src/components/HeroSection.tsx` | Place exact name/title/hook at the specified semantic locations; revise copy to scoped Smart Safety/CV story and working CTA(s), preserving typewriter/image/scroll/layout. |
| `src/components/AboutSection.tsx` | Correct profile/focus copy; remove LinkedIn and `#` BookOpen anchors plus now-unused imports; retain GitHub/mail links and layout. |
| `src/data/projects.ts` | Change badge grouping: Smart Safety sole `Main`; RF-DETR/VAE `Supporting`; remove only LLM object and unused `Brain` import. Re-author project text to the authority matrix. |
| `src/components/ProjectsSection.tsx` | No structural redesign. Change only if required to display existing badge/limit content; retain event handlers, dialog semantics, card ordering/grid, images, and GitHub action. |
| `src/components/ExperienceSection.tsx` | Minimal date/scope corrections specified by manifest; no timeline mechanics/style changes. |
| `src/components/CompetenceSection.tsx` | Minimal course-card copy/tag corrections specified by manifest; preserve all certificate-modal interaction code and assets. |
| `src/pages/PortfolioPrint.tsx`, `src/styles/print.css` | Preserve `/#/print`, return and print control; reduce to portfolio print identity/link view and remove independent resume metrics/content. Do not use it to generate the PDF. |
| `public/resume/index.html` | Replace stale full-stack resume with explicit two-page canonical ATS HTML and print CSS; local, deterministic page wrappers; real GitHub/Portfolio anchors. |
| `public/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서.pdf` | New generated-only output from canonical resume. |
| `src/test/projects-public-copy.test.ts` | Refactor into named current-production-copy/static-resume/print manifests and a separate retained-wiki manifest; add focused interaction tests. |

Do not modify `README.md`, `docs/**`, `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs`, or `public/wiki/**` for this task.

## Sequencing and dependencies
1. **Live preservation gate (before any edit).** Capture live status and target baselines; do not rely on historical `.gjc` status. In PowerShell, create an external snapshot directory such as `$env:TEMP\portfolio-preserve-<timestamp>` (never in the repository). Record `git status --short`, `git diff --name-status`, `git diff --binary -- <tracked-targets>`, and hashes (`Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256`) for every existing target. For each untracked in-scope target, copy the current file into that external snapshot and record its SHA-256. Include untracked paths in `src/data/`, `src/test/`, `public/resume/`, and any other manifest target only when live status reports them. Re-read each target immediately before editing, edit minimal hunks, and never delete/replace an untracked user file wholesale.
2. **Freeze authority and source ownership.** Record the matrix decisions in implementation notes/final report. Default to omitting the 51D baseline. Lock static `/resume/` as canonical and `/#/print` as the separate portfolio-print behavior; do not switch to React canonical source opportunistically.
3. **Revise current app copy/data.** Update metadata, Header, Hero, About, then project data with explicit badge changes; apply the minimal Experience/Competence corrections. Preserve assets, routes, styles, section order, and interaction handlers. Remove only the public LLM project object.
4. **Refactor focused tests alongside the affected sources.** Make test manifests explicit and exclude historical docs. Add assertions for exact literals/locations, allowed/banned scope, one Main/two Supporting/order, no LLM card/modal, placeholder-link absence, and existing project keyboard/dialog behavior.
5. **Author canonical resume and portfolio-print boundary.** Build exactly two explicit A4 resume page containers (not natural “at most two” pagination); use ATS-readable linear core content, stable print margins/breaks, and actual anchors. Reduce `/#/print` to shared identity/link invariants without copying resume metrics.
6. **Discover PDF tooling, generate and inspect.** Follow the executable discovery/fallback sequence below, generate from local `/resume/`, then rebuild to copy the final named PDF into `dist/resume/`.
7. **Verify and preservation closeout.** Run only relevant non-mutating gates first, followed by build/browser/PDF QA. Re-run status, changed-file list, and target hashes; compare tracked diffs and external snapshots to prove no unrelated file changed. Review all generated outputs explicitly.

## Acceptance criteria
1. The production-manifest exact literals appear at their specified locations; conflict-free-only surfaces contain no competing full-stack/AI title. No generic LinkedIn URL or `href="#"` remains in current deployed source.
2. Smart Safety is the first and **only** `Main`; RF-DETR/VAE are the two `Supporting` projects; LLM Wiki/RAG is absent only from `projects` data/card/modal while retained wiki generator/assets/routes and historical documentation remain unchanged.
3. All Smart Safety/RF-DETR/VAE text obeys the authority matrix, including separate course (`2026.01–2026.07`) and project (`2026.05–2026.07`) dates. 51D is absent unless acceptable authority is documented before editing.
4. Experience and Competence are corrected only enough to remove their public contradictions; their layout, certificate assets, modal handlers, Escape/overlay close behavior, and card/timeline structure remain intact.
5. `/resume/` is the sole editable resume and the named PDF is generated from it. The canonical HTML and PDF have exactly two A4 pages, natural Korean wrapping/no clipped glyphs, required ATS order, and clickable GitHub/Portfolio links. The named PDF is present both at `public/resume/` and built `dist/resume/` with matching hash.
6. `/#/print` still resolves through `HashRouter`, retains return and print controls, is visibly a portfolio print view, contains shared identity/link invariants, and has no detailed resume metrics, education/project dates, or competing resume narrative.
7. Current-production-copy tests inspect only manifest production files; retained-wiki checks independently validate `wiki:index` script/index metadata without requiring LLM text in `projects.ts`. Historical docs are not scanned or changed.
8. Hero/header/card/modal interactions and responsive layout remain: mobile one / desktop two project grid; Enter and Space open a card; Escape and overlay close the dialog; dialog semantics remain; CTA count is ≤3 and targets resolve.
9. No `wiki:index` run occurs unless an intentionally edited indexed Markdown input requires it. If that deliberate condition later arises, it becomes explicit reviewed scope with before/after generator and `public/wiki/*.json` hashes/diffs reported.
10. Final report uses the exact required headings below and distinguishes automated, browser, and manual-fallback results.

## Verification
### Preservation and source checks
- Before/after commands: `git status --short`; `git diff --name-status`; `git diff --check`; `git diff -- <tracked manifest targets>`; and `Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256` for existing/new affected outputs.
- Compare each untracked target with its external snapshot using hash and `git diff --no-index -- <snapshot> <current>`; report differences only for intended targets. Confirm no unlisted path changed.
- Do **not** run `npm run wiki:index` for this revision because no indexed source is intentionally changed.

### Automated checks (after implementation; no formatter suppression)
```powershell
npm run lint
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json
npm run test
npm run build
git diff --check
```
- The focused Vitest suite reads the current-production-copy manifest (`index.html`, selected current route components/data, `public/resume/index.html`) and separate retained-wiki inputs (`package.json`, generator script, existing JSON indexes). It must not read `docs/resume/**` or root historical resumes.
- Build output inspection verifies `/resume/`, the named generated PDF, and hash-route app assets are emitted.

### Browser and interaction QA
After build, serve a stable preview:
```powershell
npm run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --strictPort
```
At `http://127.0.0.1:4173/`, `/#/print`, and `/resume/`, inspect 1440×900 and 390×844: header navigation/offset, hero wrapping/profile/CTAs, project grid, Enter/Space/Escape/overlay dialog operation, current links, `/#/print` identity-only boundary, and resume/PDF links. Check that visible external links are actual GitHub/Portfolio/mail links; report an externally unreachable URL rather than replacing or masking it.

### Executable PDF discovery, generation, and inspection
1. **Discover before assuming tools.** In PowerShell, query `Get-Command msedge.exe,chrome.exe,pdfinfo,pdftotext,qpdf,python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`; test common Chromium application paths and `HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\App Paths\msedge.exe` / `chrome.exe`; invoke each selected browser with `--version`. Test parser availability non-mutatively with `python -c "import pypdf; print(pypdf.__version__)"`. Current package metadata has no Playwright/Puppeteer/pdf-lib/pdfjs dependency, so do not name one as installed without discovery.
2. **Generate deterministically.** Select the discovered Chromium browser; serve the built static source on port 4173; invoke its verified Chromium-compatible headless mode with `--headless=new --disable-gpu --no-pdf-header-footer --virtual-time-budget=5000 --print-to-pdf=<absolute public/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서.pdf> http://127.0.0.1:4173/resume/`. Record the exact executable, arguments, browser version, local URL, source hash, output hash, and timestamp. If its installed version rejects a flag, use its documented equivalent and record the substitution; never silently accept browser headers/footers.
3. **Preferred automated inspection.** Use discovered `pdfinfo` for page count/page size, `pdftotext -layout` for textual order, and either `qpdf` annotation output or a discovered `pypdf` script to assert exactly two pages, A4 dimensions, expected header/section text, Korean extraction, and two URI annotations (GitHub and Portfolio). Raster-preview both pages at 100% for clipping/orphan/glyph defects. Rebuild after PDF generation and compare the public/dist PDF hashes.
4. **Fallback/stop rule.** If no headless browser exists, do not invent a tool or hand-edit a PDF: stop PDF generation and report the blocker. If a browser exists but no CLI PDF parser exists, use its PDF viewer or locally installed Acrobat/Edge viewer to verify the two-page indicator, A4 print settings, visible text order/glyphs, and click both links manually; record it as manual fallback. If page count, A4 size, text, links, or visual integrity cannot be verified, the PDF acceptance criterion is unmet and publication stops. No package installation is in scope merely to bypass this gate.

## Escalation / Risk Gate
- Stop before publishing an unsupported operational claim or a 51D baseline without acceptable authority. Obtain direct reports/config or written user approval; otherwise preserve the matrix’s omission/caveat.
- Stop before any destructive handling of a live dirty/untracked target that lacks an external snapshot/hash.
- Stop PDF acceptance when exactly-two-A4/link/annotation verification fails; correct canonical HTML/CSS only, never hand-patch the generated PDF.
- Escalate to an **architect** only if static `/resume/` cannot satisfy the PDF gate and a route/source architecture change is truly required. Use an **executor** for bounded edits, a **critic** for claim/PDF/boundary review, and no team/ultragoal split for this bounded content revision.

## Verification Plan
The final implementation report must contain exactly these headings:
1. **Evidence used** — authority matrix decisions, including whether 51D was omitted or newly evidenced.
2. **Files changed** — every changed path and an explicit statement that nonselected historical docs/wiki artifacts were untouched.
3. **Verification run/results** — preservation, lint/typecheck/test/build/diff, browser, and retained-wiki checks; identify checks not run and why.
4. **PDF provenance** — canonical source path/hash, browser executable/version/command/local URL, output/public/dist paths, output hashes, page count/A4 result, text/link/annotation result, and manual fallback status if used.
5. **Claim decisions** — allowed qualifiers and omitted unsupported claims.
6. **Final-report open items** — unresolved direct-evidence needs (Reader/Inference queue, TensorRT deployment, ownership, 51D if omitted).
7. **Risks/mitigations** — including dirty-work handling and any external-link limitation.
8. **Routes/code intentionally preserved** — `/#/print`, `/resume/`, `/wiki/`, wiki generator/index assets, card/modal interaction, and historical artifacts.

## Pre-mortem
| Likely failure | Earliest warning | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Dirty user work is clobbered, especially an untracked target | Target is untracked/modified in live status or differs from the historical plan snapshot | External pre-edit snapshot + hash; minimal hunks; re-read before edit; post-edit `git diff --no-index`/hash comparison; never overwrite wholesale. |
| Canonical and print surfaces drift into two resumes | `/#/print` contains project metrics/dates or static resume content is copied into React | Enforce ownership manifest: static HTML/PDF canonical; print route identity/link-only portfolio view; source test plus browser QA. |
| Unsupported copy returns through stale Experience/Competence/project detail | Production-manifest search finds banned term without a limitation qualifier | Matrix-based copy, scoped negative tests, minimal corrections, and critic review before PDF generation. |
| LLM removal breaks retained wiki assertions or generator rewrites unrelated data | Tests still demand LLM in project data or a proposed verification invokes `wiki:index` | Separate wiki manifest from public project test; do not run generator absent an intentional indexed input change. |
| HTML looks fine but PDF is 1/3 pages, clips Korean, or lacks links | Browser print preview/parser reports wrong page count/size, missing text/annotations | Explicit two-page A4 wrappers and breaks; deterministic browser invocation; parser-first then visual QA; stop publication on failure. |

## Risks and mitigations
- **Evidence hierarchy ambiguity:** User-required facts and corroborating prior copy are separated in the matrix; no prior prose becomes direct implementation proof.
- **Date collision:** Course and project durations have distinct required locations and tests.
- **Design regression:** Reuse existing semantic tokens, component hierarchy, animations, grid, and modal mechanics; no new visual system.
- **Tooling absence:** Discovery is executable and fallback is explicit; no unverified dependency/tool claim or package-install scope creep.
- **Historical copy remains intentionally inconsistent:** It is excluded from deployed-source scans and reported as intentionally preserved, not silently normalized.

## Intent Reconciliation
- Confirmed by user: public/resume/index.html is the sole editable resume source; the named PDF is generated only from it; the hash print route remains a separate portfolio print view.
- The user supplied the 51D to 54D baseline directly in the task, so it is treated as user-approved wording while still not being represented as repository implementation evidence.
- No prior deep-interview specification or conflicting project plan was found for this topic.

## ADR
### Decision
Preserve the Vite/React/Tailwind portfolio architecture and visual system, make only evidence-scoped copy/data changes, use public/resume/index.html as the single editable resume source, generate the named two-page PDF from it, and keep the hash print route as a separate portfolio print view.

### Drivers
1. Preserve the existing design, routes, and user-owned dirty work.
2. Prevent unsupported deployment, ownership, Re-ID, clinical, and performance claims.
3. Eliminate resume-source drift while meeting ATS and two-page PDF requirements.

### Alternatives considered
- React print route as canonical resume: rejected because it changes static route behavior and increases coupling.
- Synchronize every historical resume/document: rejected because it expands scope and risks overwriting user work.
- Rebuild the portfolio design: rejected because the user explicitly requires minimal changes.

### Why chosen
The selected path changes the fewest production surfaces, retains all existing routes and interactions, and creates one auditable HTML-to-PDF provenance chain.

### Consequences
Historical documents may remain inconsistent by design; production-copy tests must exclude them. PDF acceptance depends on locally available Chromium and inspection tooling. Unsupported code-level facts remain qualified or omitted.

### Follow-ups
Report only unresolved implementation evidence, PDF-tooling blockers, or externally unreachable links in the final open-items section.

# RALPLAN-DR — Minimal Computer-Vision Branding Revision

## Summary
Reposition the existing React/Vite portfolio and its served resume route around **안진경 | An Jin Gyeong**, the title **실시간 영상 AI의 정확도와 지연을 함께 개선한 컴퓨터비전 엔지니어**, and the hook **정답에도 유효시간이 있습니다.** Preserve the landing-page section order, cards-to-modal interaction, `#/print` route, static `/resume/` route, `/wiki/` assets, and visual system. Make Smart Safety the first and only representative project; keep RF-DETR and VAE as supporting medical projects; remove the LLM Wiki/RAG card and resume content without deleting its wiki generator, static assets, or route.

Repository facts: the app is Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind (`package.json`; `npm run dev`, `lint`, `test`, `build`, `wiki:index`), assembled by `src/App.tsx`/`src/pages/Index.tsx`; project content is data-driven in `src/data/projects.ts` and displayed through `src/components/ProjectsSection.tsx`. `src/App.tsx` preserves `/#/print`; `public/resume/index.html` preserves the static `/resume/` route. Current print surfaces are `src/pages/PortfolioPrint.tsx` + `src/styles/print.css`, plus static resume artifacts under `docs/resume/`. The existing decision-focused PDF (`docs/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서_의사결정중심.pdf`) contains the requested CV metrics/scope, but no editable source was found for it.

## Intent Diff
- **From:** broad AI/full-stack positioning, medical-first hero bullets, four public projects including LLM Wiki/RAG, and conflicting resume variants/splits/dates.
- **To:** evidence-first computer-vision candidacy: a safety-monitoring project whose visible story connects model quality, tracking continuity, latency, and team-delivered `AI Worker → MQTT → Spring Boot → WebSocket → React`; medical work remains bounded, non-clinical supporting evidence; resume is a two-page ATS-readable CV artifact.
- **Do not change:** component hierarchy, site navigation, existing visual vocabulary, `/#/print`, `/resume/`, `/wiki/`, `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs`, or historic/internal documents unless they are the chosen production resume source/output.

## Decision Drivers
1. **Claim integrity over novelty.** No statement may invent experiments, deployment, ownership, Re-ID, clinical effectiveness, or production TensorRT use. The external AI/backend repositories are absent here; source text alone is not code/config proof.
2. **A single CV narrative.** Hero, About, Smart Safety modal, selected resume, print view, SEO metadata, and test assertions must agree on title, hook, metrics, scope, and terms.
3. **Minimal structural change.** Reuse the project data/card/modal system and print/static resume route; do not redesign the layout or remove retained wiki code/routes.

## Principles
1. Lead with the operational consequence: a correct result is useful only while timely.
2. Present each project in **problem → judgment → method/trade-off → result → ownership/limit** order.
3. Treat every number as a scoped comparison: same condition where supplied; no metric is a clinical, production, MOTA/HOTA, or Re-ID claim unless directly evidenced.
4. Separate individual contribution from team integration in the visible copy.
5. Keep Korean copy scannable on mobile and ATS-friendly in print; explicit labels and natural wrapping beat dense technology lists.

## Options
### Option A — Recommended: one served static resume source
Use `public/resume/index.html` as the canonical print-ready, two-page resume and source of the served `/resume/` route; generate `public/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서.pdf` from that route. Update `src/pages/PortfolioPrint.tsx` only enough to point to the same downloadable PDF/maintain matching identity, or explicitly label it as a portfolio print view rather than a second resume.
- **Pros:** a working public route and downloadable PDF share one source; no new routing or build architecture; final PDF can be linked from a maximum-three-CTA hero.
- **Cons:** substantial existing static HTML is stale and must be carefully simplified; static HTML and React print view can still drift.

### Option B — React print route as canonical source
Make `src/pages/PortfolioPrint.tsx`/`src/styles/print.css` the exact two-page resume and generate the named PDF from `/#/print`; retain `public/resume/index.html` only as a redirect/link shell to avoid route loss.
- **Pros:** resume copy lives with typed React source and shares styles/tooling.
- **Cons:** creates a shell/redirect behavior change and a higher drift risk; less minimal given the existing public static resume route.

**Invalidation gate:** choose Option B only when static `/resume/` cannot be made consistently two-page/clickable in the available print engine. Otherwise use Option A. In either option, do not treat the orphaned decision-focused PDF as an editable source; use it only as evidence to transcribe/verify the specified claims.

## In scope
- Brand/name/title/hook and CV-first SEO/header/hero/About wording.
- One representative Smart Safety project first; its card and modal are evidence-bounded and problem/judgment/method-trade-off/result/ownership structured.
- Supporting RF-DETR and VAE content corrected to the supplied scope; LLM Wiki/RAG removed from main project list and selected resume only.
- The served two-page resume, named PDF output, links, print behavior, and targeted regression tests.

## Out of scope
- AI Worker, MQTT/Spring/React application implementation, model retraining, deployment, benchmark reruns, data-label review, clinical validation, or new visual redesign.
- Deleting or changing the `/wiki/` generator/index assets, LLM Wiki/RAG code, `/#/print` route, or historical/internal resume notes solely because they contain retained material.
- Altering unrelated Contact, Skills, awards, certificate interaction, deployment workflow, or current user changes.

## Evidence Ledger and Open Items
### Usable evidence found
- `docs/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서_의사결정중심.pdf` supplies the requested 51D→54D features/results, staged tracking reconnect conditions/results, multi-camera latency comparisons, TensorRT same-1,800-frame comparison, RF-DETR team/personal scope, Kvasir 70/20/10, and VAE limitations.
- `docs/resume/ai-security-resume-print.html` and `.md` corroborate the pipeline/tracking/Reader-Inference/TensorRT comparison wording, but are copy artifacts, not implementation proof.
- `src/data/projects.ts` currently contains Smart Safety first and TensorRT comparison values; it currently makes unsupported Drop-old and tracking implementation claims, uses Kvasir 70/20/10, and exposes LLM Wiki/RAG as a supporting card.
- `docs/resume/resume-evidence-checklist.md` says Queue/Reader evidence was checked in external reports, but those reports are not present.

### Final-report open items (must be explicit; never silently fill)
1. **Reader/Inference/bounded queue/drop-old:** absent AI Worker code/config or the cited original report in this repo. Omit from public copy unless implementer obtains direct code/config evidence; do not infer it from prose.
2. **TensorRT production use:** no engine/config/deployment proof exists here. Describe only a **same-1,800-frame PyTorch-vs-TensorRT comparison validation** (7.022→3.839 ms; 84.278→119.544 FPS), never an applied production optimization, until code/config proves it.
3. **Control integration ownership:** pipeline documents claim end-to-end integration but do not precisely partition contributors. State the team system/integration separately from the individual’s supplied work (feature expansion, staged reconnect, latency analysis, and interface integration); do not state sole ownership.
4. **Production/deployment and clinical claims:** no evidence; omit. RF-DETR is a team research/prototype UI and VAE is non-clinical anomaly-candidate work.
5. **Resume generation provenance:** the desired PDF exists but its source is absent. Record the selected source, generator/command, resulting SHA-256, page count, and output path in the final report.

## File-level changes

Remove the LLM Wiki/RAG object from this public data array only. |

| `README.md` | Update public positioning/run documentation only if it still advertises LLM/RAG as a main portfolio focus; retain `wiki:index` because code/routes remain. |

## Sequencing and dependencies
1. **Freeze evidence language and choose resume option.** Create a claim matrix from the evidence ledger before editing. Resolve the five open items as omit/caveat/verified; choose Option A unless static rendering fails. This prevents existing contradictory 70/20/10 vs 70/20/10 claims, stale title variants, and unsupported implementation wording from leaking into final copy.
2. **Update website identity and primary narrative.** Modify metadata, header, hero, and About with the exact brand/title/hook, no more than three CTAs, CV-first delivery chain, and scope labels. Preserve anchors, scroll behavior, responsive classes, visual tokens, and route tree.
3. **Revise public project data and tests together.** Re-author Smart Safety then RF-DETR/VAE in `projects.ts`; remove only the LLM object from public project data; adapt rendering only if labels require it. Update the focused Vitest contract in the same slice.
4. **Produce one canonical two-page resume and link it.** Rewrite selected source in ATS order, use supplied education/training exact dates, retain click targets, generate the named PDF in the served location, and align `/#/print` identity. Keep the route and source of retained wiki/rag code untouched.
5. **Run copy, app, visual, PDF, link, and diff verification.** Fix only defects surfaced by gates; record all unresolved evidence items and the final artifact provenance in the final report.

## Exact content contract
### Shared brand
- Name: `안진경 | An Jin Gyeong`
- Title: `실시간 영상 AI의 정확도와 지연을 함께 개선한 컴퓨터비전 엔지니어`
- Hook: `정답에도 유효시간이 있습니다.`
- Hero must state CV candidacy, tracking continuity/latency, and `AI Worker → MQTT → Spring Boot → WebSocket → React`; CTAs ≤ 3.

### Smart Safety
- Lead card/first modal. Use explicitly scoped comparisons: feature input **51D→54D** by adding upper-body tilt, vertical drop, and speed; **F1 89.29→93.49**, **FP −38.6%**, **FN −38.9%**.
- Tracking wording: no Re-ID. Describe staged reconnect using predicted position, normalized center distance, and candidate count; result **ID Switch 8→1**, track coverage **35.76→49.70**. Do not call this MOTA/HOTA or generic tracking accuracy.
- Latency wording: same multi-camera condition **mean 11.789→6.101 ms (−48.2%)**, worst-camera p95 **14.719→7.159 ms (−51.4%)**.
- TensorRT wording: comparison validation only unless code/config later proves deployed use: same 1,800 frames, PyTorch **7.022 ms / 84.278 FPS** vs TensorRT **3.839 ms / 119.544 FPS**.
- Do not mention Reader/Inference/bounded queue/drop-old absent source-code/config proof. Do not claim full ownership; distinguish personal method work and interface integration from team pipeline/control integration.

### Medical projects
- RF-DETR: team project, Kvasir **70/20/10**, individual Elastic Deformation/Grid Distortion and bbox validation, team mAP@50 **86.2%**, PyQt5/OpenCV video/webcam application. Never say real-time, FPS, clinical use, personal model ownership, or production deployment without new evidence.
- VAE: train normal-only due to limited lesion-location labels; reconstruction-error map; fixed threshold is limited by brightness/noise; individual dynamic threshold; candidate visualization only—no diagnosis/clinical/performance implication.

### Resume
- Header/profile must use shared title/hook and CV evidence scope.
- Education exactly: `건양대학교 의공학과 학사 | 2026.02 졸업`; `SK쉴더스 지능형 애플리케이션 개발 과정 5기 | 2026.01–2026.07`.
- ATS sequence: contact/links, profile, skills, selected project experience, education, awards/credentials. Korean text must wrap naturally; no dense tables for ATS core content. Keep GitHub and Portfolio actual anchors clickable.
- Exactly/at most two A4 pages; final filename exactly `안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서.pdf`.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Site title, header, hero, About, selected resume, and `/#/print` show the exact name/title/hook without older Full-Stack/AI 융합보안 title conflicts.
2. Hero renders at desktop and mobile without clipped/overlapping title, hook, CTAs, profile image, or fixed header; it exposes ≤3 CTAs and all targets work.
3. Project cards retain existing mobile-one/desktop-two grid, keyboard Enter/Space opening, Escape/overlay closing, dialog semantics, and Smart Safety appears before RF-DETR/VAE.
4. Smart Safety content satisfies every specified metric/wording constraint, never says Re-ID, never claims MOTA/HOTA/clinical/deployment, and does not claim Reader/Inference/queue/drop-old or TensorRT production use without new code/config evidence.
5. RF-DETR and VAE satisfy supplied team/personal/non-clinical boundaries; no public project card/modal or selected resume includes LLM Wiki/RAG. `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs`, public wiki indexes, and their route assets remain intact.
6. The selected resume has requested education/training strings, ATS order, clickable GitHub/Portfolio anchors, Korean wrapping that does not cut glyphs, exactly two pages, and generated PDF with the exact filename/path.
7. Tests and static-copy checks encode the new boundaries; lint, app typecheck, tests, build, wiki index generation, link checks, and `git diff --check` pass without formatting or warning suppression.
8. Final report includes: **Evidence used; Files changed; Verification run/results; PDF provenance (source/command/path/hash/page count); Claim decisions; Final-report open items; Risks/mitigations; Routes/code intentionally preserved.**

## Verification plan
### Automated gates (do not run during this planning assignment)
```bash
npm run lint
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json
npm run test
npm run wiki:index
npm run build
git diff --check
```
Run `npm run wiki:index` after the text change because it deliberately indexes allowed root/doc markdown; confirm no retained wiki route/code has been removed. Re-run `npm run test` after generated indexes if those snapshots/contract assertions depend on them.

### Focused content/unit checks
- Extend `src/test/projects-public-copy.test.ts` to assert exact title/hook and Smart Safety metric strings; assert `Re-ID`, clinical outcome language, and production-TensorRT language are absent from public project/resume source; assert no LLM Wiki/RAG project object remains.
- Preserve existing keyboard/dialog tests; add/retain a test that the first rendered card is Smart Safety and that the modal exposes scope/limits.
- Add a simple static resume/source test or deterministic review checklist for exact filename, education strings, two valid `https://` anchors, and absence of LLM/RAG in the selected resume.

### Browser/link QA
1. Start the built preview (`npm run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1`) and inspect desktop 1440×900 and mobile 390×844.
2. At both sizes verify hero line wrapping, fixed-header offset, CTA count/targets, CTA focus visibility, image crop, section navigation, project-card keyboard open/close, modal horizontal overflow, and resume download.
3. Crawl/activate every visible external and local anchor in Header/Hero/About/Projects/Contact/resume; validate `mailto:`, GitHub, portfolio, `/resume/`, the named PDF, and `/#/print`; report unreachable external URLs rather than masking them.

### PDF generation and inspection
1. Serve the canonical static `/resume/` source locally and print with the installed Edge/Chromium headless PDF capability (with header/footer disabled) to `public/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서.pdf`; record the exact invocation and SHA-256.
2. Inspect the generated PDF with a page-count/text extractor and visual preview: exactly two A4 pages; ordered header → profile → skills → Smart Safety → RF-DETR → VAE → education/awards; no isolated Korean characters, clipped bullet/metric lines, blank third page, or truncated URL.
3. Open PDF links and verify GitHub/Portfolio annotations are clickable; inspect both pages at 100% and print preview. Build once more to confirm the output is copied to `dist/resume/`.

## Escalation / Risk Gate
Stop before publishing any claim when it cannot be backed by the supplied PDF or direct code/config. The implementer must request/locate the external AI Worker/backend/frontend repositories or original reports for Reader/Inference queue implementation, TensorRT production application, and exact team ownership. Without them, omit the queue statement, call TensorRT comparison validation, and use explicit team/personal labels. Escalate to an **architect** only if preserving both `/resume/` and `/#/print` requires a route/source architecture decision beyond Option A/B; use an **executor** for implementation, a **critic** for claim-boundary/PDF review, and no team/ultragoal split is warranted for this bounded content revision.

## Pre-mortem: three likely failure scenarios
| Scenario | Earliest warning | Mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unsupported implementation/production claim returns through stale copy | A search finds `drop-old`, `Re-ID`, `production`, `real-time`, or a contradictory TensorRT verb in Hero/project/resume | Maintain a claim matrix and negative tests; replace with scoped comparison/omit before PDF generation. |
| PDF looks correct in HTML but overflows or mangles Korean when printed | Print preview shows a third page, orphaned metrics, clipped right edge, or broken glyph/URL wraps | Lock A4 widths/margins/font fallback, avoid multi-column dense body tables, regenerate and inspect text + raster preview at each layout adjustment. |
| Route/source drift or LLM removal breaks retained wiki behavior | `/resume/` or `/#/print` yields stale copy, `wiki:index`/tests fail, or a public LLM card remains | Declare one resume source, test visible routes/links after build, remove only the `projects` data object, and retain `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs`/wiki assets untouched. |

## Risks and mitigations
- **Conflicting legacy copies:** Several root/docs/public resume variants use old titles, dates, splits, Dice/FPS, or broad ownership. Limit production changes to the canonical route/source and explicitly identify non-selected variants as historical; do not publish them as current output.
- **Untracked user work:** latest recorded status artifacts show modified `README.md`/`src/components/ProjectsSection.tsx` and untracked `.omo/`, `src/data/`, tests, docs/resume materials, and multiple planning documents. Current branch is `main` (`.git/HEAD`); live `git status` could not be queried in the restricted read-only role. Re-read files before edits and never revert/delete those changes.
- **Design regression:** existing design uses Pretendard/Inter with blue-violet semantic tokens, a 1200px container, mobile-first grids, and card/modal interactions (`DESIGN.md`, `src/index.css`, `tailwind.config.ts`). Reuse those primitives; no raw-color or layout-system replacement.
- **PDF source ambiguity:** no editable source for the best evidence PDF exists. Select one source before edits, document provenance, and avoid claiming a PDF was regenerated until command output and inspection prove it.

## Summary
Reviewed immutable planner artifact `C:/Users/user/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/developer-portfolio/.gjc/_session-019f8965-6c6d-7000-b9d6-68269c24cbe1/plans/ralplan/019f8965-6c6d-7000-b9d6-68269c24cbe1/stage-01-planner.md` at SHA-256 `09ea2868300af6d292153cc064724da7d627e82c61b7d72f16ebe5f84f36bec4`; the path/hash pair is corroborated by the ralplan `index.jsonl` receipt. The plan is evidence-aware and preserves the site architecture, but it should be tightened before execution around canonical resume ownership, non-mutating wiki verification, historical-file scope, and deployed-surface tests. No product files were mutated and no gates or formatters were run.

## Claims
- The requested brand/content revision can remain data- and copy-focused: routing is already limited to `/` and `/print` under `HashRouter` (`src/App.tsx`), while the static resume is served from `public/resume/index.html`.
- Smart Safety/RF-DETR/VAE copy is centralized in `src/data/projects.ts`, and `src/components/ProjectsSection.tsx` already preserves one-column mobile/two-column desktop layout, Enter/Space opening, Escape/overlay closing, and dialog semantics. A redesign is unnecessary.
- The supplied decision-focused PDF supports the bounded numerical story and contribution language: Smart Safety metrics, staged reconnect conditions, same-input latency/TensorRT comparisons, RF-DETR team/personal scope, Kvasir 70/20/10, and VAE limitations (`docs/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서_의사결정중심.pdf`). It is evidence, not an editable source.
- Direct repository evidence does not establish Reader/Inference queue implementation, deployed TensorRT use, clinical effectiveness, or sole ownership. The planner correctly omits or narrows those claims (`stage-01-planner.md:49-65, 91-111`).
- The existing static resume is stale and structurally not yet a two-page source: it has one `.page` wrapper and broad Full-Stack copy (`public/resume/index.html:6-7, 550-558`). Re-authoring that served file is justified if Option A is fixed as the canonical source.

## Analysis
### Spec compliance
The plan substantially satisfies the user constraints: it explicitly prohibits redesign, invented ownership/deployment/clinical/Re-ID claims, deletes only the LLM public project object, and preserves `/#/print`, `/resume/`, `/wiki/`, the wiki generator, and static assets. Its exact content contract scopes every number and distinguishes individual work from team integration. Smart Safety is designated first and representative, while RF-DETR and VAE are bounded supporting work.

Two corrections are needed to make compliance enforceable rather than aspirational. First, Option A still assigns multiple possible roles to `PortfolioPrint`; that leaves an implementation-time choice and a second editable fact surface. Second, tests must scan actual deployed surfaces rather than historical docs, or evidence gates can both miss the canonical resume and fail on intentionally retained records.

### Architecture and antithesis
The strongest antithesis is that “align all copies” is not a source-of-truth architecture. `public/resume/index.html`, the generated PDF, `PortfolioPrint.tsx`, and a docs resume cannot all be independently maintained current artifacts without recurring drift. Updating old docs to reduce confusion further expands the blast radius and conflicts with the explicit historical-file exclusion.

The same issue appears in verification. `npm run wiki:index` is not a read-only gate: `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs:7-12, 74, 157-180` recursively consumes repository/docs markdown and writes two public JSON assets. Because the planner itself records untracked/user-owned docs, an unconditional generator run can ingest unrelated changes and alter the preserved `/wiki/` surface.

### Constructive synthesis
Lock Option A before any edits:
1. `public/resume/index.html` is the sole editable resume and the served `/resume/` source.
2. `public/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서.pdf` is generated-only; never hand-edit it. Record source, exact browser invocation, output path, page count, hash, and link annotations.
3. `/#/print` remains functional but is explicitly a portfolio print view, not a second resume. Keep only shared identity/hook/link invariants and avoid duplicating detailed resume metrics. If the static source cannot meet the two-page/clickable requirement, stop and revise the plan to Option B rather than switching opportunistically during implementation.
4. Non-selected `docs/resume/*` artifacts remain untouched and are excluded from “current public copy” tests/links.
5. Test deployed source files directly; reserve visual wrapping, glyph clipping, exact page count, and PDF annotation checks for browser/PDF QA.

This preserves current routes and design while making source ownership explicit. The tradeoff is that the React print view is intentionally a different artifact; clear labeling and limited shared literals are safer than pretending two full resumes share one source.

## Root Cause
The plan identifies content evidence correctly but does not finish the artifact-ownership decision. It still treats source selection, route compatibility, generated output, historical records, and mutation-producing verification as loosely coordinated copies rather than distinct roles with one owner and explicit invariants.

## Findings
1. **MEDIUM — `stage-01-planner.md:26-36`: Resolve the canonical-resume branch before implementation.** Option A leaves `PortfolioPrint` as one of three behaviors and therefore retains two editable resume narratives. Fix by declaring static HTML the sole resume source, PDF generated-only, and `/#/print` a clearly separate compatibility/portfolio print surface; amend the plan before using Option B.
2. **MEDIUM — `stage-01-planner.md:123-131`: Do not regenerate broad wiki indexes for unrelated copy edits.** The generator recursively reads all docs and writes retained assets, so it can absorb unrelated user changes. Use non-mutating route/diff/test verification unless an intentionally changed indexed source requires regeneration.
3. **MEDIUM — `stage-01-planner.md:73-78`: Remove the historical resume file from the Option A change set.** Editing `docs/resume/ai-security-resume-print.html` under Option A contradicts the historical-file exclusion. Leave it untouched and exclude it from current links/tests.
4. **MEDIUM — `stage-01-planner.md:133-136`: Require automated checks against only deployed copy surfaces.** Existing `src/test/projects-public-copy.test.ts:21-27` includes historical docs but omits `public/resume/index.html`; a checklist alternative is not repeatable. Add automated exact/negative assertions over deployed files, and keep rendering/PDF properties in QA.
5. **LOW — `stage-01-planner.md:68`: Remove unverified placeholder social targets during link cleanup.** About currently contains generic `https://linkedin.com` and `href="#"` targets (`src/components/AboutSection.tsx:63-70`). Remove them unless exact candidate URLs are verified; do not invent replacements.

## Recommendations
1. Amend sequencing step 1 to record the Option A ownership contract before editing; treat Option B activation as a plan-change gate.
2. Narrow the initial change set to `index.html`, Header/Hero/About, `src/data/projects.ts`, rendering only if labels require it, `PortfolioPrint.tsx`/print CSS only for route-preserved identity, `public/resume/index.html`, the generated named PDF, the focused test, and README only if its top-level positioning remains contradictory. Do not touch historical resume docs or wiki assets by default.
3. Make Smart Safety the only `Main` project and RF-DETR/VAE `Supporting`; remove only the LLM object from `projects`, preserving wiki code/assets/routes.
4. Replace historical-doc aggregation in `projects-public-copy.test.ts` with explicit deployed-surface inputs. Assert exact brand literals; Smart Safety/RF-DETR/VAE ordering and badge roles; scoped metrics; forbidden claims; exact education dates; canonical resume anchors; absence of LLM/RAG from selected resume/project data; and preservation of `/print` routing.
5. Split verification into non-mutating gates first (lint, typecheck, tests, build, diff check), built-preview route/link/responsive QA, then PDF generation/inspection. Do not run `wiki:index` unless its intended inputs changed; if it must run, generated diffs become explicit reviewed scope.
6. For PDF generation, use exactly two explicit A4 page containers, disable browser headers/footers, wait for fonts before printing, inspect text and raster output, verify GitHub/Portfolio link annotations, and confirm the built artifact exists under `dist/resume/` with the exact Korean filename.
7. Remove the no-op BookOpen link and generic LinkedIn root during the already-planned About copy update unless evidence supplies real destinations.

## Architectural Status
`WATCH`

## Code Review Recommendation
`COMMENT`

## Tradeoffs
| Option | Benefits | Costs/Risks | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Static `/resume/` canonical; PDF generated; `/#/print` separately labeled | Minimal route/build change, ATS-friendly source, direct static serving, clear PDF provenance | Shared identity is duplicated; compatibility print view needs explicit scope | Recommended after ownership correction |
| React `/#/print` canonical; `/resume/` redirect/shell | Typed source and shared application tooling | Changes static route behavior, depends on JS/hash routing, less minimal | Use only if static A4/link gate fails and plan is amended |
| Keep all print/resume/docs copies synchronized | Preserves current documents verbatim | Highest drift and unsupported-claim risk; violates minimal scope | Reject |
| Always run `wiki:index` | Exercises generator end-to-end | Can ingest unrelated docs and rewrite preserved assets | Reject unless indexed inputs intentionally change |
| Automated deployed-source checks plus browser/PDF QA | Repeatable claim gates and correct separation of source vs rendered behavior | Slight test maintenance cost | Recommended |

Planner artifact reviewed: `C:/Users/user/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/developer-portfolio/.gjc/_session-019f8965-6c6d-7000-b9d6-68269c24cbe1/plans/ralplan/0

## Verdict
**ITERATE**

Planner artifact reviewed: `C:/Users/user/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/developer-portfolio/.gjc/_session-019f8965-6c6d-7000-b9d6-68269c24cbe1/plans/ralplan/019f8965-6c6d-7000-b9d6-68269c24cbe1/stage-01-planner.md`, SHA-256 `09ea2868300af6d292153cc064724da7d627e82c61b7d72f16ebe5f84f36bec4`. The direction is strong, but execution would still require guessing and could overwrite existing dirty work or leave public claim conflicts.

## Claim Checks
- **Artifact identity verified.** The ralplan `index.jsonl` records the exact planner path, stage `planner`, `stage_n: 1`, and supplied SHA-256.
- **Repository architecture verified.** `package.json` defines `dev`, `lint`, `test`, `build`, and `wiki:index`; `src/App.tsx` uses `HashRouter` with `/print`; `public/resume/index.html` serves the static resume payload; `src/data/projects.ts` drives `src/components/ProjectsSection.tsx`.
- **Project grouping needs a more exact implementation instruction.** `ProjectsSection.tsx` renders separate arrays by `badge`. Today Smart Safety, RF-DETR, and VAE are all `Main`; LLM Wiki is `Supporting`. Removing LLM alone does not make Smart Safety the first and only representative project. RF-DETR and VAE must explicitly change to `badge: "Supporting"`, and acceptance should assert exactly one `Main` plus two supporting projects.
- **The principal evidence PDF exists and contains most planned numbers.** Extracted text from `docs/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서_의사결정중심.pdf` contains F1 89.29→93.49, FP/FN reductions, ID Switch 8→1, Track Coverage 35.76→49.70, multi-camera latency, TensorRT comparison, RF-DETR scope, VAE limitations, and the 2026.01–2026.07 course string. However, it says features were added to produce a 54D input; it does not verbatim establish the `51D→54D` baseline. The 51D value appears in `docs/resume/resume-evidence-checklist.md`, whose cited original reports are absent. The plan overstates that the PDF itself supplies the complete 51D→54D claim.
- **Date sources conflict and require explicit precedence.** The decision-focused PDF gives course dates 2026.01–2026.07 and Smart Safety project dates 2026.05–2026.07. Most editable resume sources and `PortfolioPrint.tsx` give the course as 2026.05–2026.07. The plan states the desired course date but does not explicitly separate course attendance from project duration or identify why the PDF/user instruction overrides the other sources.
- **The current served resume and print surfaces match the plan's diagnosis.** `public/resume/index.html` is a stale, single `.page` full-stack resume; `src/pages/PortfolioPrint.tsx` is a separate two-page full-stack resume with disallowed RF-DETR real-time/FPS and VAE Dice claims. The named output `public/resume/안진경_컴퓨터비전_AI엔지니어_이력서.pdf` does not yet exist and is correctly treated as a new generated artifact.
- **Additional public conflicts are definitely in scope but absent from the file plan.** `src/components/ExperienceSection.tsx` publicly calls RF-DETR real-time, describes VAE as lesion/tumor detection, and says the SK course is in progress. `src/components/CompetenceSection.tsx` publicly claims practical deployment and full-stack positioning. These conflict with the plan's no-real-time RF-DETR, candidate-only VAE, no unsupported deployment, exact-date, and single-narrative rules. Preserving those components' layout/interactions does not require preserving inaccurate copy.
- **Current test structure is not suitable for the proposed acceptance checks without an explicit refactor.** `src/test/projects-public-copy.test.ts` defines `publicProjectSources` using only ProjectsSection/project data, while `portfolioPublicCopy` includes historical `docs/portfolio-submission-audit.md` and `docs/resume/ai-engineer-resume.md` but excludes `index.html`, Header, Hero, Experience, Competence, and `public/resume/index.html`. It also entangles LLM-card assertions with retained wiki-index assertions. A generic instruction to “replace expectations” risks either missing production surfaces or modifying historical/user files to make an over-broad scan pass.
- **Design and routes are correctly identified.** `DESIGN.md`, `src/index.css`, and `tailwind.config.ts` confirm the blue-violet semantic-token system, 1200px container, mobile-first one/two-column project grids, and current modal behavior. `Index.tsx` confirms the section order to preserve.
- **Dirty-work risk is real and only historically observed.** Recorded 2026-07-02 status artifacts show `README.md` and `src/components/ProjectsSection.tsx` modified and `src/data/`, `src/test/projects-public-copy.test.ts`, `DESIGN.md`, resume documents, and `.omo/` untracked. Those are stale snapshots, not a live baseline. Several planned targets are themselves untracked, so ordinary `git diff` cannot recover their pre-edit contents.

## Missing Evidence
- A source-authority matrix is missing. It must distinguish: explicit user-approved facts, direct implementation/config evidence, extracted prior-resume copy, corroborating copy only, and unsupported claims. Publication status and required qualifier must be stated per claim. In particular, resolve the basis for 51D and the precedence of course/project dates; do not silently promote prior resume prose to implementation evidence while rejecting equivalent prose elsewhere.
- Live dirty-state evidence is unavailable. The execution plan needs a mandatory start-of-work `git status --short`, tracked diff capture, and content/hash snapshots for untracked target files, followed by an end-of-work changed-file comparison.
- Exact PDF tooling is unverified. The plan names “installed Edge/Chromium” and a page-count/text extractor but gives no verified executable/path, deterministic invocation, annotation-check tool, or stop/fallback rule if those capabilities are absent.
- Per-surface copy expectations are unclear. Acceptance criterion 1 requires the exact name/title/hook in title, Header, Hero, About, selected resume, and print view, while the file table only asks Header to show the name and About/print to be consistent. Executors should not guess whether the title and hook must be repeated verbatim in every component or merely be conflict-free.
- The instruction for `/#/print` under Option A is under-specified: “point to the PDF,” “maintain matching identity,” and “label as portfolio print view” are materially different outcomes. One behavior must be selected and tested.

## Approval Boundary
Read-only claim inventory, live-status capture, and preservation snapshots may proceed. Product edits, generated-index writes, PDF generation, and publication are not approved until the plan resolves the production-surface manifest, dirty-file merge protocol, evidence authority, exact project grouping, and canonical resume/print behavior. Historical/internal resume artifacts and retained wiki code/assets remain outside modification unless a revised plan proves they are selected production inputs.

## Summary
- **Clarity:** Strong goal, content contract, sequence, and route/design constraints; weak on per-surface repetition, the exact `/#/print` outcome, and badge-level implementation.
- **Verifiability:** Good high-level gates and visual/PDF scenarios; current test manifests cannot enforce them, and PDF/link tooling is not operationally specified.
- **Completeness:** Missing `ExperienceSection.tsx` and `CompetenceSection.tsx`, exact Main/Supporting changes, a live dirty-work protocol, and course-vs-project date separation.
- **Big Picture:** The CV-first, evidence-bounded direction fits the repository and preserves route/design architecture.
- **Principle/Option Consistency:** The plan says not to touch historical/internal documents, but the file table asks to update or reduce `docs/resume/ai-security-resume-print.html` even under Option A. It also rejects prose as implementation proof while treating an orphaned prior resume PDF as sufficient evidence without an explicit authority rule.
- **Alternatives Depth:** Option A/B trade-offs are reasonable, but Option A still leaves multiple unselected `/#/print` behaviors and lacks a decision about explicit two-page DOM structure versus natural pagination.
- **Risk/Verification Rigor:** Claim, PDF, and route pre-mortems are useful. Dirty-work clobbering, stale Experience/Competence copy, untracked-file verification, and possible wiki-index rewrites need explicit controls.

## Required Changes
1. **Add a production-surface manifest and close the public-copy gaps.** Include `index.html`, Header, Hero, About, `src/data/projects.ts`, ProjectsSection, Skills if changed, `src/components/ExperienceSection.tsx`, `src/components/CompetenceSection.tsx`, `PortfolioPrint.tsx`, `public/resume/index.html`, the generated PDF, and README as applicable. Specify minimal copy-only corrections for Experience/Competence while preserving their layout and interactions. Exclude unselected historical docs from public-copy negative scans.
2. **Make project grouping exact.** State that Smart Safety remains the sole `Main`; RF-DETR and VAE become `Supporting`; LLM is removed only from the public `projects` array; the unused icon import is cleaned up. Add acceptance for one Main, two Supporting, Smart first, and no LLM card/modal while wiki assets remain.
3. **Define evidence authority claim by claim.** For 51D→54D, dates, all metrics, ownership, interface integration, and system-chain wording, record source, authority class, allowed public wording, qualifier, and rejection condition. Explicitly distinguish course dates `2026.01–2026.07` from Smart Safety project dates `2026.05–2026.07`, if those are user-approved. If 51D lacks approved evidence, omit the baseline or escalate for requirements/source confirmation rather than deriving it.
4. **Resolve the canonical-resume branch before execution.** Keep Option A as the default only if that is the selected decision, then prescribe one exact `/#/print` behavior and acceptance test. Remove the instruction to edit/reduce `docs/resume/ai-security-resume-print.html` under Option A; leave non-selected historical/user artifacts untouched and scope tests away from them. Resolve “exactly/at most two pages” to **exactly two A4 pages**.
5. **Reconcile per-surface acceptance with file instructions.** State exactly where the verbatim name, title, and hook appear and where only absence of conflicting titles is required. Define approved/banned language by surface so negative tests do not reject legitimate limitation wording such as “non-clinical” while still blocking clinical-effectiveness, deployment, sole-ownership, Re-ID, RF-DETR real-time/FPS, and TensorRT-production claims.
6. **Refactor tests into explicit scopes.** Create separate source manifests for current web production copy, selected static resume source, React print route, and retained wiki artifacts. Add actual tests for Enter, Space, Escape, overlay close, dialog semantics, exactly one Main, card order, and modal limits; the existing suite does not currently test all of those. Preserve independent `wiki:index`/incident-metadata assertions without requiring LLM text in `projects.ts`.
7. **Add a dirty-work merge protocol.** Before edits, capture live status, tracked diffs, and hashes/copies of every untracked target; edit current contents in minimal hunks; never replace or delete untracked user files wholesale; re-read before each edit; and finish with status/name-only comparison proving no unrelated path changed. `git diff --check` alone is insufficient because key targets are untracked. Add dirty-target clobbering to the pre-mortem.
8. **Make PDF and preservation verification executable.** Name the local URL, stable preview port, browser executable/invocation, header/footer flags, page-count/text/annotation inspection method, and a stop/fallback rule. Verify exactly two A4 pages, text order, Korean glyph rendering, both clickable links, filename/path/hash, and `dist/resume/` copy. Record before/after hashes or diffs for `scripts/generate-wiki-index.mjs` and retained `public/wiki/` assets when running `wiki:index`, and report any generator-caused change rather than masking it.
